What We Do

Our Services

Complete industrial solutions from plant movement to storage. One partner for all your heavy lifting and logistics needs.

Plant & Machinery Installation

Expert handling, offloading and positioning of heavy industrial equipment. From chillers and generators to printing presses and MRI scanners.

  • Factory relocations
  • Equipment positioning
  • Mechanical & electrical
  • Precision alignment

Logistics & Transport

FORS accredited road transport across the UK and Europe. Safe, efficient delivery of your valuable equipment with full tracking.

  • UK & European coverage
  • FORS accredited
  • Just-in-time delivery
  • Specialist vehicles
Learn More

Mobile Crane Hire & Contract Lifting

CPA contract lifting with fully insured operations. From 10te city cranes to 500te heavy lifters — we manage the entire lift.

  • CPA contract lifting
  • Appointed person
  • Lift supervision
  • Method statements

Engineering Solutions

Bespoke fabrication, steelwork modifications and onsite engineering. We make the 'round peg fit the square hole'.

Lifting Assurance Advisors

Expert consultancy for safe lifting operations. Pre-lift planning, method statements, risk assessments and compliance auditing.

Why Simmons

Why Hire Simmons?

We don't just move equipment — we solve complex industrial challenges. From hospitals to data centres, our expertise ensures your project is completed safely, on time and on budget.

Fully Insured & Compliant

CPA contract lifting, fully insured operations. All work carried out to LOLER regulations with comprehensive risk assessments.

Industry Certified

CHAS, SafeContractor, Constructionline, Elite GB certified. Ariba Network registered and Builder's Profile approved.

33+ Years Experience

Trusted since 1992. Decades of expertise in plant movement, crane operations and industrial logistics across the UK.

Expert Team

Qualified appointed persons, lift supervisors, riggers and engineers. CSCS, CPCS and NPORS certified operatives.

UK & European Coverage

Based in Croydon with nationwide coverage. European logistics network for cross-border equipment transport.

24/7 Support

Emergency response available around the clock. Dedicated project managers for every job, big or small.
